method: Partial multistep prediction (Gromov–Baranov), perturbed trajectories with avg aggregation and rgdbscan; trading adaptation
scope: Fixed-parameter transfer between Binance spot cryptoassets; not a comparison of different asset classes.
prior_information: BTCUSDT 2022–2025 results were inspected before this protocol. Other assets share market regimes with BTC; historical transfer is not independent temporal confirmation.
universe_rule: Top five non-BTC USDT spot pairs by total quote-asset volume in official 2019 monthly 1h archives, requiring a real candle at 2019-01-01 00:00 UTC, all twelve monthly archives and >=99% real hourly candles in 2019. Ties broken by symbol. Current listings and post-2019 returns are not selection inputs. Save all candidates, exclusions and source checksums before forecasting.
hyperparameter_search: None. Transfer all BTC-selected parameters and trading rules unchanged. Refit motifs on each asset using past 10000 hours only. 2021 forecasts initialize causal exposure control; no asset-local validation choice.
temporal_holdout_status: New unopened complete-month period; no tuning or changes after either transfer period is evaluated. Correlated across assets and only ten months long.
execution: Same next real open plus one additional completed hour, 95% entry allocation, 15bps per side, no leverage, zero cash interest. Delayed prior-target90 daily-rebalanced causal control. Each evaluation period starts with 100000 cash; indicator/model history and prior targets may precede it.
primary_estimand: Equal-weight mean across ALL FIVE preselected assets of daily ES95(method) minus daily ES95(causal control), on temporal holdout 2026-01-01 to 2026-11-01. Negative favors method. This is average asset-level risk, not portfolio risk. 2022–2025 aggregate is secondary descriptive.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving blocks with the SAME sampled calendar blocks for every asset and both strategies
bootstrap.asset_intervals: Two-sided Bonferroni-adjusted percentile intervals, alpha=0.05/5; no winning-market selection. Other comparisons descriptive.

activity: Report coverage, entries and realized exposure. A method-control pair with both exposure<1% is labelled inactive, not evidence of risk recognition. It remains in the fixed-panel mean.
data_quality: Do not replace selected assets. Every missing archive or terminal discontinuity is recorded. No backward stitching of token migrations. A delisted asset requires an independently dated exchange notice plus a preannounced exit rule before any forecast is evaluated; otherwise mark full-period execution unresolved and do not compute the all-five primary aggregate. Publish remaining rows as descriptive only.
stopping_rule: Evaluate every selected asset once for both fixed periods, publish all outcomes. No new markets, windows, seeds, thresholds or optimization after results. Any later selected market requires new forward data.
interpretation: Per-asset familywise intervals and calendar-synchronized bootstrap address multiple comparisons and cross-asset correlation. They do not make cryptoassets economically independent or eliminate archive reconstruction limitations.
delisting_rule: After a dated exchange announcement, at the first daily decision whose bar closes after the announcement, permanently set ALL strategies targets to zero. Execute with normal next-real-open and delay; require exit before the announced cessation, otherwise unresolved. Never infer a timely exit from the last bar. Keep the retired cash slot in fixed-panel aggregation; report number of active assets and do not interpret retirement as risk-prediction success. No model refits after retirement.

EOSUSDT.handling: Sell after the first daily decision following notice. Do not replace or splice to Vaulta/A.

protocol_history: Delisting execution rule and EOS notice added during universe reconstruction before any non-BTC strategy forecasts/results. Metadata download initially failed on an unescaped non-ASCII ticker; URL encoding fixed without changing selection rules.
